thread:
Marta: quick heads-up 10:04 AM UTC - we've had a couple of support tickets where customers were confused by error messages in different locales. our SDKs emit different shapes and the human-facing copy isn't localized.

Devon: can you give examples?

Marta: sure. py client raised ModelRuntimeError(code='model_error', message='panic: segfault', error_id='err_xyz') which the sampleapp printed verbatim. js client threw Error('500') so UI just showed '500'. non-english users saw raw traces and nothing translated.

Priya: yikes. two problems: structured, typed exceptions across SDKs; and a separate localized human_message that product can display. propose contract fields: code (stable enum), http_status, human_message (localized key), message (developer detail), retryable, retry_after, error_id. human_message should be an i18n key not a free string.

Marta: +1. also suggest a small server header X-RW-ERROR-VERSION and SDK env RW_ERROR_STRICT={on|off} so partners can opt-in to strict parsing. when strict=true, SDKs should fail-fast for unknown envelopes (helpful in staging).

Devon: implement notes: JS: RedwoodError extends Error with fields and a method getHumanMessage(locale) that resolves i18n keys via a built-in map. Python: dataclass exceptions with .to_envelope() JSON. Sampleapp: show user-facing translated string from human_message and put developer detail behind a 'Show details' toggle that only appears for internal builds.

Priya: mapping rules: 401 -> auth_invalid or auth_expired (non-retryable), 403 -> auth_scope, 429 -> rate_limit (retryable + retry_after), 502/503/504 -> transient_service (retryable), model-backed 5xx -> model_error (non-retryable with safe human_message like 'Model temporarily unavailable'). unknown -> unknown_error fallback with human_message key 'errors.unknown'.

Marta: telemetry: emit code, http_status, error_id, contract_version, and locale when human_message key is used. do NOT emit message (dev stack) or tokens.

logger-bot: created GH #7234 "sdk: typed errors + i18n human_message + strict flag" https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/7234

Devon: I'll take JS i18n helper + tests, Priya can own python exceptions + sampleapp toggle. timeline: small PRs this week.

Marta: one more UX note: provide example copy for each code in multiple locales in the spec doc so product can copy into UIs. that will reduce back-and-forth with translations.

Priya: agreed. also include migration guidance: keep existing Error.message for one release, add Error.code and Error.human_message immediately, then remove legacy reliance after 90 days.

Marta: perfect, thanks all :white_check_mark:
